missions.title: Mission 01 — The Qalat Road
briefing: Afghanistan, late 2001. An allied prisoner is held in the compound beyond the valley. Choose the riverbed, road or terraces to reach him.
Hold interact beside the POW to free him. Silencing the radio operator holds back the early warning. Expect armour on the road home; destroy it and extract with all seven standing.
debrief: The prisoner is home, the armour is destroyed, and all seven made it out.
The valley route is open. The squad carries its surviving loadout into the next mission.
